summary: Iteration 26 tested the ANRE visa reminder link and the admin visa panel. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (4 new iter26 + 15 iter25 regression). GET /api/admin/operators/visas includes past (-10), 30-day and 90-day visas, excludes 91 days, sorts ascending, returns correct days_left, gives 403 to subscribers and hides _id/history/doc_path. The cron reminds a confirmed 30-day visa exactly once and skips past/unconfirmed ones. The captured email HTML contains href=https://<host>/dosare-anre?tip=vizare with the 'Comandă dosarul de vizare' button, passes mailer._assert_safe_email and escapes the company name. No backend errors from run_visa. Frontend: one bug found and fixed. After login, the logged-out redirect landed on '/' instead of /dosare-anre?tip=vizare. Cause: AfterLogin read and removed sessionStorage den_next during render, and React.StrictMode renders twice, so the second render saw null. Fixed in App.js and retested: login now lands on /dosare-anre?tip=vizare with vizare selected and the banner shown. No dossier is created on open or reload, only after clicking anre-new (which created a 'Vizare periodică' dossier). The banner hides when the kind changes, and plain /dosare-anre defaults to 'nou'. The admin visa panel shows the past row red (#9b2c2c text on #fdecec background) with 'depășită cu 5 zile', 20 days amber with 'în 20 zile', 60 days green with 'în 60 zile' plus 'neconfirmată', excludes 120 days, and keeps date order. Regression: the operator visa confirm button and the templates panel still work.

minor.issue: Only HTTPException is caught around send_email. mailer._assert_safe_email raises ValueError, e.g. when the Host/x-forwarded-host is numeric or internal (127.0.0.1:8001 when the cron hits the backend directly). That error would abort the whole background loop, so remaining operators get no reminder. Catch Exception, or build the base URL from a configured env value (e.g. a PUBLIC_APP_URL) instead of the request Host header. The Host header is also client-controlled.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: den_next was consumed during render, so StrictMode's double render redirected to '/' after login. It is now read via a useState initializer and removed in useEffect.

issues: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') parses as UTC, so browsers west of UTC show the visa date one day earlier. Format the ISO string directly.
'în 1 zile' / 'depășită cu 1 zile' is ungrammatical; use singular 'zi' for 1.
The URL keeps ?tip=vizare after ordering. Returning from the editor shows the mail banner again; consider clearing the query string after the order.
The banner is also shown to the platform admin.

action_items: Review and keep the AfterLogin fix in App.js.
In run_visa, catch generic exceptions per operator, and build the email base URL from configuration rather than the Host header.
Optional: timezone-safe date display in VisaPanel and singular 'zi' wording.
critical_code_review_comments: VisaPanel has no error/loading state: if the request fails, the panel silently stays hidden.
adm_visas loads all operators within 90 days with no limit. This is fine at current scale.
